How it works

Win. Compete. Map. Repeat.

Real cash prizes, global leaderboards, and a cleaner planet. Here's what KrapMaps is all about.

01 / Find a bin

Find a bin anywhere in the world.

Open KrapMaps. Verified bins around you appear instantly. Travelling? Walking? Never search for a bin again — community-powered coverage across 12 countries.

12 countries 615+ bins mapped Community-powered
NEARBY BINS (5)
02 / Quests

Complete quests. Earn rewards daily.

Log in for your daily bonus, complete challenges, and rack up points. New quests reset every 24 hours — there's always a reason to come back. You earn 100 points for every contribution.

Daily challenges Login bonus Weekly quests
03 / Compete

Climb the global leaderboard.

Top 3 mappers each month win FREE Premium. Join Team Crimson or Team Azure and compete by bins mapped or total points. Monthly and all-time rankings — your reputation never expires.

Monthly leaderboard Top 3 win Premium Crimson vs Azure
04 / Win

Points. Cash. Amazon vouchers.

Redeem your points for real rewards. $100 Amazon voucher at 50,000 pts, $250 at 150,000 pts, $500 at 300,000 pts. Top 1% of mappers unlock Premium-exclusive prizes — the more you map, the more you earn.

Up to $500 Amazon Premium rewards Top 1% prizes
